import json,pathlib,subprocess,time
root=pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
settings=json.loads((root/'foreground-command.json').read_text())
state=dict(started_unix=time.time(),status='executing_real_training_cell')
(root/'foreground-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(state))
try:
 with (root/'foreground.log').open('xb') as log:
  result=subprocess.run(settings['command'],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=86490,stdin=subprocess.DEVNULL)
 text=(root/'foreground.log').read_text()
 expected='CARTPOLE_REMOTE_OK '+json.dumps(dict(action='run',nonce=settings['nonce']))
 state.update(status='completed' if result.returncode==0 and expected in text.splitlines() else 'client_ended_without_completion_receipt',exit_code=result.returncode)
except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:state['status']='client_deadline_reached'
finally:
 state['finished_unix']=time.time();(root/'foreground-state.json').write_text(json.dumps(state,indent=2))
